name: Dead Shelf Detector - Prime Shelf Optimizer

parameters.content:
## Dead Shelf Detector - Prime Shelf Optimizer

### How it works

This workflow runs on a daily schedule or manually to detect stagnant, high-risk shelf inventory and recommend merchandising actions. It reads catalog, sales, inventory, and planogram data from Google Sheets, joins the sources, computes risk metrics, filters and ranks problem SKUs, then sends the top candidates to an AI merchandiser for structured recommendations. The workflow writes action tickets back to Google Sheets, sends a Slack digest to stores, and records a run log for auditing.

### Setup steps

- Configure Google Sheets credentials and confirm the sheet ID plus required tabs for catalog, sales rollup, inventory, planogram, action queue, and run log.
- Configure Google Gemini credentials for the Tier 2 AI Merchandiser chain and verify the structured output parser matches the expected recommendation fields.
- Configure Slack credentials and set the target channel or recipients for the store digest.
- Review the Config & Constants node values, especially sheetid, as_of_date, t_stagnant_days, and max_units_30d.
- Enable or adjust the Schedule 01:00 trigger after testing the workflow with the Manual Test Run trigger.

### Customization

Adjust the stagnant-day and unit thresholds, Tier 1 filter logic, capital-at-risk ranking, AI batch limit, guardrail rules, ticket fields, and Slack digest format to match store operations and merchandising policy.

@[youtube](iDW5lD-AHxM)

## Triggers and constants

Starts the workflow either on the 01:00 schedule or by manual test, then initializes shared configuration values such as sheet ID, analysis date, and stagnation thresholds.

## Read source sheets

Pulls the core operational datasets from Google Sheets: product catalog, sales rollup, inventory, and planogram data.

## Join and enrich data

Combines the four source tabs on store and SKU identifiers, adds category-cohort statistics, and computes shelf-risk metrics such as days to expiry, days unsold, velocity ratio, and price index.

## Filter and classify risks

Applies the first-pass dead-shelf filter and assigns rule-based actions and spoilage flags before AI review.

## Prioritize AI candidates

Sorts suspect items by capital at risk and limits the batch size so only the highest-priority SKUs are sent into the AI merchandising step.

## AI merchandising review

Uses a Gemini-backed LLM chain with structured output parsing to generate merchandising recommendations for the capped list of high-risk shelf items.

## Guardrails and tickets

Normalizes the AI output, applies guardrail fields, and builds an actionable ticket with IDs, price-update indicators, ERP flags, and review dates.

## Publish store actions

Writes the recommended actions to the Action_Queue sheet and sends a Slack digest for store teams.

## Record run summary

Builds and writes a run log containing run date, planogram row count, suspects found, and the number of items sent to AI.

nodes.name: Merge Input Sources
nodes.notes: ONLY code node. Joins 4 tabs + category cohort stats (needs aggregation, cannot be done with Set).

nodes.name: Calculate Metrics
nodes.notes: Phase 2+3 KPIs: Vr, Pi, DRR, days-to-clear, floors, category band, cannibalisation.

nodes.name: Filter by Tier 1 Conditions
nodes.notes: Phase 1: prime zone + stagnant for T days + <= max units in 30d + has stock.

nodes.name: Set Rule Actions
nodes.notes: Decision matrix. Priority: 1 expiry > 4 dead category > 2 price > 3 margin > none.

assignments.name: rule_action
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const c = $('Set Configuration Constants').first().json; const u = Number(c.unsold_min_days); const x = $json; if (x.days_to_expiry < Number(c.expiry_critical_days) && x.total_on_hand > Number(c.min_onhand_liquidate) && x.days_unsold >= u) return 'DEMOTE_AND_LIQUIDATE'; if (x.cat_velocity_band === 'DEAD' && x.days_unsold >= Number(c.dead_unsold_days)) return 'DELIST_CANDIDATE'; if (x.cat_velocity_band === 'HIGH' && x.price_index > Number(c.price_index_limit) && x.days_unsold >= u) return 'TEST_PRICE_REDUCTION'; if (x.gross_margin_pct > Number(c.high_margin_pct) && x.days_to_expiry > Number(c.safe_expiry_days) && x.days_unsold >= u) return 'RELOCATE_SECONDARY'; return 'NO_RULE_MATCH'; })() }}

nodes.name: Limit AI Batch Size
nodes.notes: Cost/rate-limit guard: only the top N by capital at risk go to Gemini.

nodes.name: AI Merchandising Agent
nodes.notes: Gemini confirms/overrides the rule engine. Output is schema-validated by the parser.

messageValues.message:
You are a retail merchandising analyst for a grocery and FMCG chain. You review exactly ONE prime eye-level SKU that is not selling. A deterministic rule engine already proposed rule_action. Confirm it or override it using the evidence in the context, then return the structured decision.

ALLOWED final_action VALUES
DEMOTE_AND_LIQUIDATE: expiry or spoilage risk. Move all shelf stock to CLEARANCE_BIN or ENDCAP_SECONDARY, markdown towards break_even_price, freeze replenishment.
TEST_PRICE_REDUCTION: category demand is healthy but this SKU is priced above peers. Keep 1 facing in PRIME_EYE_LEVEL for the test. new_price = mrp minus the SMALLER of price_gap_to_median and margin_cushion. Never below floor_price.
RELOCATE_SECONDARY: high margin, long shelf life, slow mover. Move to BOTTOM or REACH, cut facings to 1, NO price change, hand the prime space to replacement_sku if one is provided.
DELIST_CANDIDATE: the whole category is dead. Move stock to BACKROOM and stop reordering.
KEEP_MONITOR: evidence is too weak or conflicting to act. No price change, no movement.

HARD RULES
1. Never price below floor_price. Only DEMOTE_AND_LIQUIDATE may go lower, and never below break_even_price. Never above mrp.
2. Never invent SKU ids. replacement_sku must be copied exactly from the context or be an empty string.
3. Do not choose DELIST_CANDIDATE unless days_unsold is at least delist_min_days_unsold.
4. If spoilage_flag is true and days_to_expiry is below 60, prefer DEMOTE_AND_LIQUIDATE.
5. If cannibalization_flag is true and price_index is above 1.15, prefer TEST_PRICE_REDUCTION.
6. If rule_action is NO_RULE_MATCH, choose the most defensible action. KEEP_MONITOR is allowed.
7. For actions with no price change set new_price equal to mrp.
8. reasoning is at most 2 sentences citing the numbers that drove the decision. store_note is one imperative sentence for the store associate.
9. confidence is a number from 0 to 1.

nodes.name: Implement Guardrails
nodes.notes: Deterministic safety net AFTER the AI: price floors, delist guard, SKU-id whitelist, qty caps.

assignments.name: final_action
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const c = $('Limit AI Batch Size').item.json; const a = $json.output; return (a.final_action === 'DELIST_CANDIDATE' && c.days_unsold < Number($('Set Configuration Constants').first().json.dead_unsold_days)) ? 'KEEP_MONITOR' : a.final_action; })() }}

assignments.name: guardrail_applied
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const c = $('Limit AI Batch Size').item.json; const a = $json.output; const eff = (() => { const c = $('Limit AI Batch Size').item.json; const a = $json.output; return (a.final_action === 'DELIST_CANDIDATE' && c.days_unsold < Number($('Set Configuration Constants').first().json.dead_unsold_days)) ? 'KEEP_MONITOR' : a.final_action; })(); if (a.final_action === 'DELIST_CANDIDATE' && eff === 'KEEP_MONITOR') return 'DELIST_BLOCKED_TOO_RECENT'; const f = a.final_action === 'DEMOTE_AND_LIQUIDATE' ? c.break_even_price : c.floor_price; if (['DEMOTE_AND_LIQUIDATE','TEST_PRICE_REDUCTION'].includes(eff) && (a.new_price < f || a.new_price > c.mrp)) return 'PRICE_CLAMPED'; if (a.replacement_sku && a.replacement_sku !== c.replacement_sku) return 'REPLACEMENT_SKU_REJECTED'; return 'NONE'; })() }}

assignments.name: from_location
assignments.value: ={{ $('Limit AI Batch Size').item.json.aisle + '/' + $('Limit AI Batch Size').item.json.bay + '/' + $('Limit AI Batch Size').item.json.shelf }}

assignments.name: to_zone
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const c = $('Limit AI Batch Size').item.json; const a = $json.output; const eff = (() => { const c = $('Limit AI Batch Size').item.json; const a = $json.output; return (a.final_action === 'DELIST_CANDIDATE' && c.days_unsold < Number($('Set Configuration Constants').first().json.dead_unsold_days)) ? 'KEEP_MONITOR' : a.final_action; })(); return (eff === 'KEEP_MONITOR' || eff === 'TEST_PRICE_REDUCTION') ? c.zone_tier : a.target_zone; })() }}

assignments.name: move_units
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const c = $('Limit AI Batch Size').item.json; const a = $json.output; const eff = (() => { const c = $('Limit AI Batch Size').item.json; const a = $json.output; return (a.final_action === 'DELIST_CANDIDATE' && c.days_unsold < Number($('Set Configuration Constants').first().json.dead_unsold_days)) ? 'KEEP_MONITOR' : a.final_action; })(); if (eff === 'DEMOTE_AND_LIQUIDATE' || eff === 'DELIST_CANDIDATE') return c.shelf_units; if (eff === 'RELOCATE_SECONDARY') return Math.min(a.move_units, c.shelf_units); return 0; })() }}

assignments.name: target_facings
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const c = $('Limit AI Batch Size').item.json; const a = $json.output; const eff = (() => { const c = $('Limit AI Batch Size').item.json; const a = $json.output; return (a.final_action === 'DELIST_CANDIDATE' && c.days_unsold < Number($('Set Configuration Constants').first().json.dead_unsold_days)) ? 'KEEP_MONITOR' : a.final_action; })(); return eff === 'KEEP_MONITOR' ? c.facing_count : (eff === 'TEST_PRICE_REDUCTION' ? 1 : Math.min(a.target_facings, c.facing_count)); })() }}

assignments.name: replacement_sku
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const c = $('Limit AI Batch Size').item.json; const a = $json.output; const eff = (() => { const c = $('Limit AI Batch Size').item.json; const a = $json.output; return (a.final_action === 'DELIST_CANDIDATE' && c.days_unsold < Number($('Set Configuration Constants').first().json.dead_unsold_days)) ? 'KEEP_MONITOR' : a.final_action; })(); return (['RELOCATE_SECONDARY','DEMOTE_AND_LIQUIDATE','DELIST_CANDIDATE'].includes(eff) && a.replacement_sku === c.replacement_sku) ? c.replacement_sku : ''; })() }}

assignments.name: new_price
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const c = $('Limit AI Batch Size').item.json; const a = $json.output; const eff = (() => { const c = $('Limit AI Batch Size').item.json; const a = $json.output; return (a.final_action === 'DELIST_CANDIDATE' && c.days_unsold < Number($('Set Configuration Constants').first().json.dead_unsold_days)) ? 'KEEP_MONITOR' : a.final_action; })(); if (!['DEMOTE_AND_LIQUIDATE','TEST_PRICE_REDUCTION'].includes(eff)) return c.mrp; const f = eff === 'DEMOTE_AND_LIQUIDATE' ? c.break_even_price : c.floor_price; return Math.round(Math.min(c.mrp, Math.max(a.new_price, f)) * 100) / 100; })() }}

nodes.name: Create Action Ticket
nodes.notes: Adds ticket_id, POS price flag, ERP flag, 14-day (AI-chosen 7-30) review date.

nodes.name: Update Action Queue
nodes.notes: OUTPUT tab. Upsert on ticket_id = safe to re-run the same day (no duplicates). POS / ERP / store app read from this tab.

nodes.name: Send Slack Notification
nodes.notes: One digest per run (executeOnce). Full detail stays in Action_Queue.

assignments.name: capital_at_risk_in_scope
assignments.value: ={{ Math.round($('Limit AI Batch Size').all().reduce((s, x) => s + Number(x.json.capital_at_risk), 0) * 100) / 100 }}
